truth_boundary: Ceilings bound request volume and near-zero operating cost. Ceilings are not targets. A BUDGET_HELD run is not a failed run and must never be reported as provider failure or ranking failure.

indexnow._rationale: Matched to the lane's real cadence, 2026-09-01. indexing-submit.yml fires on workflow_run after BOTH 'Scheduled Content Release' and 'Citation OS Daily', each daily — so the lane legitimately attempts ~2x/day, ~14x/week. The previous ceiling of 1/day and 7/week was exactly half that, so the lane was BUDGET_HELD roughly every other run by construction: 15 attempts in the 7 days to 2026-09-01, against a ceiling of 7. A permanently-held lane is an inert lane. 3/day and 16/week is the 2 automated runs plus one manual workflow_dispatch, and sits inside provider-cost-controls' envelope (<=5 daily, <=25 weekly). IndexNow has no per-call cost; this ceiling exists to avoid hammering the endpoint, not to control spend. If the triggering cadence changes, change this.
